;Disasters and accidents
*A magnitude-6.6 earthquake strikes near [[Tobelo]], on the [[Indonesia|Indonesian]] island of [[Halmahera]]. No injuries or damage were reported, nor was there a [[Tsunami warning system|tsunami alert]]. [http://www.toledoblade.com/Nation/2014/12/21/Magnitude-6-6-earthquake-hits-eastern-Indonesia-no-reports-of-injuries-no-tsunami-expected.html (AP via Toledo Blade)] [http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/strong-earthquake-hits-east-indonesia-no-tsunami-threat/articleshow/45594326.cms (India Times)]

;International Relations
*[[Egypt]] temporarily reopens its [[Border checkpoint|border crossing]] with [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], which had been closed since October, until 4 pm Monday. [http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/118496/Egypt/Politics-/Egypt-opens-Rafah-border-crossing-for-two-days.aspx (Ahram Online)]
*Due to [[avian influenza]] in the United States, [[South Korea–United States relations|South Korea suspends US imports]] of poultry. [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/international-business/South-Korea-halts-US-poultry-imports-due-to-bird-flu-in-US/articleshow/45592630.cms (Reuters via Times of India)]

;Law and crime
*After an eight year informal [[Moratorium (law)|moratorium]] on the death penalty [[Capital punishment in Jordan|Jordan executes]] eleven men. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2014/12/jordan-hangs-11-after-lifting-execution-ban-201412218257159168.html (Al Jazeera)]
